scope: Shared launcher scrollbars for the grid, app lists, search and clipboard.

checks.command: Scroll the installed Golden Gate app grid in a disposable KDE neon Plasma 6.8.1 Wayland session and capture the active and idle states with Spectacle.
checks.detail: At 2× scale the active and idle frames differ only across the 6-device-pixel-wide handle, 8 device pixels inside the right edge. The integrated launcher tree matches the captured candidate.

approval: Maintainer approved the before, scrolling and idle comparison for release.
coverage_limits: Rendered on Golden Gate in dark mode. The other launcher views and Tahoe share the scrollbar. No separate capture of those views, light mode or X11.
